run_uncompress_s2ef_datasets: run the uncompress script to decompress S2EF dataset files from a compressed directory to an output directory
run_read_lzma: run the read_lzma function to decompress a single lzma compressed file to an output path
run_decompress_list_of_files: run the decompress_list_of_files function to decompress a single input output file pair
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to build an argparse parser with ipdir opdir and num_workers arguments
run_main: run the main function to parallel decompress all txt.xz and extxyz.xz files using multiprocessing
